purpose: Current-design ACT4 architectural certification subcohort for the local RV64 dual-issue OoO core.

placement.reason: ACT4 executes self-checking ISA and privileged-architecture payloads on the complete NpcSimTop core; it complements, but does not replace, directed RTL, DiffTest, mini-system or lightweight-Linux evidence.

excluded_cases.reason: The production IFU PTW, LSU PTW and TLB implement Svnapot 64 KiB leaves; the mutually exclusive unsupported-extension payload is replaced by the four Sv39 Svnapot positive/reserved-encoding cases.

required_observations: all 100 implementation-matched npc-rv64-ooo-current ELF cases execute exactly once
the generated 101-case inventory contains exactly one declared inapplicable payload for a Svnapot-absent implementation, and the four Sv39 Svnapot positive/reserved-encoding payloads remain mandatory
each case exits with return code zero and exactly one TOHOST PASS marker
TOHOST FAIL, BAD TRAP and RTL assertion failure markers are absent
production RTL, L1 simulator, ACT4 config and all selected ELF identities match before and after execution
runtime binary copies and objcopy intermediates are removed before PASS
the checker rejects missing cases, duplicate terminal events, assertion markers, input drift and a simulator from another design identity
non_claims: OoO internal owner, holder, ready/valid or recovery coverage
system software, Linux userland or device-stack coverage
synthesis, STA, power, area, CPI or PPA qualification
